description: **Presence is now declared, never derived.** Every flag declares exactly one of `Required()`, `Optional()` or `Default(v)`, and every positional arg one of `ArgRequired()`, `ArgOptional()` or `ArgDefault(v)`. Declaring none or two is a registration-time hard error, `Default(nil)` is refused with a redirect to `Optional()`, and `ArgRequired(bool)` is gone. Optional flags deliver nil (bools become real tri-state), compound flags no longer get a silent empty default, a mutex member declares its own absence, a `Flag` struct literal no longer registers, the dumped schema carries `presence` on every flag and arg entry, MCP tool schemas take requiredness from the declaration (required bools now appear), help renders exactly one presence part per line, and `ctx.Provided(name)` reports whether the invocation caused a value.
